name: Reiji Kutsuki
source:
Reiji, in spite of his upbeat music, is passive and detached to a fault. Spending his early years in an abusive home severely limited his emotions, and despite his new family redirecting it towards benevolence, Reiji’s nihilism couldn't be unlearned. Among their efforts was music therapy, which resonated and changed his life, giving an outlet for his damaged mind to be channelled into art. With a distinct sound and voguish identity, Reiji is one of the few musicians to have a debut top the singles chart.
